7107.title: Course 05 — Practical Digital Skills
7107.content:
What is Content Creation School?

It is an online educational program where you learn content creation and digital skills.

Why would you want to learn that?

1️⃣✅️TO START A FREELANCING BUSINESS
You can start a freelancing business offering contrnt creation skills and/or social media management. Almost every week, we have small business owners looking for someone to help them with their online marketing. Content Creation School gives you the skill to be able to do this.

As the designer of Content Creation School, I have been hired many times by companies to do this work.

You will learn from my over 10years of real world experience. I no longer offer the service but I train others to have the skill and whenever possible, help them to find clients.

I have already assisted some of our graduates to find clients who are paying them on a monthly retainer basis.

2️⃣✅️ PACKAGE AND SELL YOUR EXPERTISE
You can create content to package and sell your knowledge as books, courses, and training.
Are you an expert with knowledge and experience that can help other people?

Maybe you are an expert in the filed of:
💠Health
💠Fitness
💠Personal finance
💠Business finance
💠I.T and software
💠Relationships
Etc...

You can learn how to package, market and sell your expertise. All these will be achieved through content creation. We have a special bonus specific for trainers, consultants, and coaches.

3️⃣✅️ MARKET YOUR BUSINESS
Are you a service business, ecommerce, or tech business?
Do you manage your online marketing in-house?
Then you or your marketer can benefit from Content Creation School. We teach not just content creation but sigital skills and how to use more than 20 different tools to:
💠 enhance your brand
💠 reach more people
💠 generate leads through copywriting
💠 manage your customers and increase your sales revenue.

4️⃣✅️ BUILD A BRAND AND GROW YOUR AUDIENCE.
You could build your personal brand and grow the number of followers you have. It all happens through specifc content creation skills.

Monetization of your brand will differ from person to person. Once you have the objectives, you can build your audience through Content Creation skills in alignment with your strategy.

5️⃣✅️ BUILD YOUR CAREER - SHINE AT WORK.
Modern businesses require modern skills which are often not taught in school. Get skills that will make you more valuable in employment.

One young lady recently told me "I am shining with the skills you taught me."
Job security is no longer assured but when you have in-demand skills, you give your career more room for growth.

💠💠Learn all the above in Content Creation School.

It is a 3in1 program.
➡️1️⃣ Learn Content Creation Skills
➡️2️⃣ Learn Basics of Digital Marketing
➡️3️⃣ Learn Digital Tools and Software Skills

ABOUT CONTENT CREATION SCHOOL

✅️Duration: 30 days
✅️Venue: Online
✅️Time for class: study any time during the day
✅️Daily review chats Monday to Thursday at 18hrs.
✅ ️Live video review at 18hrs twice a week.
✅️ PRICE: K1,250 [$49]

23197.title: Course 11 — Practical Digital Skills
23197.content:
🚀 Turn Words Into Sales — Even If You’ve Never Written Copy Before

Most people post content every day…
And still struggle to sell.

Not because their products are bad —
But because they don’t understand how words influence human decisions.

This course teaches you exactly that.

Copywriting is the #1 income skill behind:

  • Online sales

  • Personal brands

  • Freelancing

  • Digital marketing

  • Business growth

  • Social media conversions

If you can write persuasively, you will never struggle to sell again.

✅ What You’ll Learn Inside This Course

By the end of this course, you will be able to:

  • Understand how real copywriting works (not guesswork)

  • Grab attention instantly using proven techniques

  • Tell stories that emotionally hook your audience

  • Turn boring features into powerful benefits

  • Use psychology to influence buying decisions

  • Apply persuasion principles used in advertising

  • Use power words that trigger action

  • Write magnetic headlines that stop scrolling

  • Apply copywriting formulas for ads, posts & sales pages

✅ Who This Course Is For

This course is perfect for:

  • Beginners who want to learn copywriting from scratch

  • Freelancers who want a high-income digital skill

  • Coaches & consultants building personal brands

  • Business owners writing their own marketing content

  • Social media creators who want content that converts

  • Anyone tired of posting content that doesn’t sell

NO prior experience required.

✅ How This Course Is Structured

The course moves from foundation → psychology → persuasion → execution:

  • Copywriting basics & mindset

  • Attention & storytelling

  • Features vs benefits

  • Human psychology & buying triggers

  • Persuasion science

  • Power words

  • Copy formulas

  • Headline mastery

This is not theory.
This is practical, usable writing skill.

✅ What Makes This Course Different

Unlike random online tutorials, this course:

  • Teaches psychology, not just templates

  • Shows you how humans actually make buying decisions

  • Gives you frameworks you can reuse forever

  • Works for social media, ads, websites, emails & sales pages

  • Builds a real monetizable skill, not motivation

✅ What You’ll Be Able To Do After This Course

  • Write content that sells instead of just entertains

  • Create stronger personal brand messaging

  • Convert viewers into buyers

  • Offer copywriting as a freelance service

  • Improve sales for your business or clients

⚡ If you're tired of guessing what to write…
And you want words that actually make money —
Welcome to Copywriting 101.
